episode_row: correct skip day produced no signal

commits.subject: feat(scheduler): surface skip days (log + DM + dashboard), not silent no-pick
commits.body:
On a skip day — every candidate below the MDP pick bar (~80%), so holding the streak is optimal — the daemon computed predictions then returned silently: no DM, no log line, no dashboard signal. A legitimate skip was indistinguishable from a hang (the 2026-06-18 "why no suggestion?" incident: best was Bo Bichette 75%, correctly skipped, but nothing said so). Now a skip surfaces on three channels: - log: run_single_check prints "SKIP — best

below the pick bar; streak holds at " instead of the silent pick_result-None return. - DM: run_day delivers a one-time skip notice — idempotent (skip_notified_at), gated to dm delivery mode, send-failure leaves it unmarked so a later cycle retries, and it carries across same-day restarts so it stays once-per-day. - dashboard: a "SKIP TODAY" banner read from scheduler_state.json. Persists skip_summary + skip_notified_at on SchedulerState (defaulted so existing state files still load). Hardened after an adversarial Codex (gpt-5.5) review: - build_skip_summary never raises in the daemon loop (coerces probabilities, drops non-finite, returns None on unusable data; JSON-native types only). - skip DM phrased tentatively — an early cycle may still flip to a pick, and a DM can't be retracted — and the notify is wrapped so it can't take down the loop. - skip fields carry across restart only within the same date; the dashboard banner is suppressed once a pick exists for today (the pick file is authoritative, and survives the restart that resets pick_locked). render_skip_banner guards non- finite p. (Codex's cross-day "leak" finding was a false flag — load_state is date-partitioned.) 19 TDD tests (red→green); 184 green across the scheduler/web/strategy blast radius. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context)
